view.changed.ask: offer to fill it in, one short line

args.name: email
args.doc: The email used for the order, as the shopper said it.

moves.say: {find: FH-20418 | sam.rivera@example.com} fills step 1 and looks the order up, as the Find button does.
moves.doc: Fill step 1 with the order number and email and look the order up exactly as the Find button does; on success the form moves to step 2. Refused with the reason: no such order, email mismatch, not delivered, outside the window.

moves.say: {next} moves the returns form on to its next step, as Continue does.
moves.doc: Validate the step in front like the Continue button and move to the next one. Refused, naming the missing fields.

args.name: step
args.doc: A step already reached, 1 to 6: 1 find your order, 2 items, 3 reason, 4 resolution, 5 collection, 6 review.

moves.say: {step: 3} as you start talking about that step of the returns form; it opens, scrolls into view and is ringed.
moves.doc: Open a step of the returns form the form has already reached, and ring it.

args.name: field
args.doc: A field of the returns form by its name: order_number, email, reason, condition, resolution, exchange_variant_<product_id>, collection, pickup_window.

args.name: value
args.doc: One of the field's values as the form names them: doesnt_suit_room, unused_in_packaging, refund, pickup, weekday_morning. For order_number the order number, FH-20418; for email the address the shopper said.

moves.say: {fill: reason | doesnt_suit_room} at the start of the sentence that says it, one field per sentence: "Let's put down that it doesn't suit the room."
moves.doc: Set one field of the returns form, as the voice says it. Refused, with the field's values, when the value is not one of them.

args.name: product_id
args.doc: The order line's product id, as find_order gives it.

args.name: qty
args.doc: How many to return, 1 up to the number ordered (a numeral, "1", is read as 1); 0 takes the item off the return.

moves.say: {item: product-id | 1} as you name an item of the order being returned.
moves.doc: Choose an item of the order to return, and how many.
Press Submit return, once the shopper has said yes. Refused, naming the step, while a step still needs something.

args.name: facet
args.doc: A facet of the rail, as listing_viewed names it: Material, Finish, Category, On sale, Price.

args.name: value
args.doc: One of that facet's values as the rail lists it: Ceramic, Walnut; for a bands facet, a band's label (Under $300); for a toggle, its name.

moves.say: {filter: Material | Ceramic} as you say it; the option is ringed and ticked on the page's own filter rail.
moves.doc: Turn on one value of any options, toggle or bands facet on the listing in front, exactly as a click does: the grid, the count and the address update in place. Refused, with that facet's values, when this page does not offer it.

args.name: value
args.doc: The value to turn off; left out, the facet's value that is on (or its range).

moves.say: {unfilter: Material | Ceramic} as you take that filter off.
moves.doc: Untick one option that is on. Refused, with the options that are on, when it is not.

moves.say: {clear} as you say the filters are off.
moves.doc: Take every filter on the listing in front off.

args.name: facet
args.doc: A bands or range facet: Price.

moves.say: {range: Price | | 300} for up to 300, {range: Price | 300 | 400} for a span.
moves.doc: Set a bands or range facet to [min, max]. On a bands facet a span that is exactly one band presses that band; a span across bands rings each band it takes in and sets the span; a span no band reaches is refused with the bands. Both left out takes the facet off.

moves.say: {price: | 500} for up to $500, {price: 200 | 800} for a range.
moves.doc: The same as listing.range on the page's Price facet; kept for the older name.

args.name: by
args.doc: The page's sort, as it names it: Featured, Price, low to high, Price, high to low, On sale first.

moves.say: {sort: Price, low to high} as you say how the pieces are ordered.
moves.doc: Choose the listing's sort with its own control.

slices.doc: the returns form: the step in front and which fields hold something, by name, never their values

fields.name: field
fields.doc: The field that just changed, by name.

fields.name: filled
fields.doc: The names of the fields that hold something.

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: The return's reference, once submitted: RT-20418-1.

events.doc: A field of the returns form was filled or changed.

events.note: {by} is on step {step} of the returns form
events.doc: The returns form moved to another step.

events.ask: thank them and say what happens next, in one line
